training.checkpoint_selection: none; save the single post-update state

fairness: Same trajectory split, luma targets, flow labels, model initialization seed, architecture, loader settings, loss, optimizer and update count for both generators.
adapter_notes: Upstream config names a non-existent HDF5Dataset; benchmark adapter uses the pinned DynamicH5Dataset-derived class.
The stock binary search returns an arbitrary index on duplicate timestamps; adapter uses np.searchsorted(side='right') for inclusive right endpoints.
A right-endpoint frame sequence [I1,...,I10,I10] makes the upstream length=num_imgs-1 loader yield all 10 physical event intervals without a leading empty interval.
The upstream loader multiplies stored flow by observed event duration; adapter stores interval displacement divided by that duration so the loader returns the shared per-interval displacement.
The pinned PerceptualSimilarity import expects removed skimage.measure.compare_ssim; the runner supplies a runtime alias to skimage.metrics.structural_similarity without editing third-party source.
